label: Pets and companion animals identification and traceability
description: Dogs, cats, rabbits, ferrets, and companion animals identification using microchips, tags, tattoos, passports, and registration systems. Covers welfare, breeding, sale, pet travel, responsible ownership, zoonotic disease prevention, and illegal import enforcement.
